name: Imagine Worldwide: Tanzania (Founders Pledge)
beneficiaries_note: The model's name: Imagine Worldwide: Tanzania (Founders Pledge).

missing_data.note: Measured: the children are counted, and the effect is from randomised trials of the same tablet programme (Malawi); the move to Tanzania is an external-validity question, which Founders Pledge adjusts for.

summary: Tablet-based adaptive learning in Tanzanian primary schools, expanding from Malawi. Founders Pledge's page gives £10 per pupil and learning gains of over 0.3 standard deviations; we turn them into income with Founders Pledge's own 2023 education method.

sections.title: Founders Pledge's figures
sections.explainer: Founders Pledge's own figures, as its recommendation page states them. It publishes no spreadsheet for this recommendation, so these are the model's only evaluator rows.

sections.title: Pounds to dollars
sections.explainer: charityevals' step: the page states costs in pounds; we convert at the 2024 average rate.

sections.title: From test scores to units of value
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, using Founders Pledge's own method: its 2023 education report turns a rise in test scores into higher lifetime earnings (19.1% more a year per standard deviation, 17.5% of it kept, from 8 years on for 40 years, shared with the household). The page's figure stops at test scores; we apply the method as its Imagine Worldwide model does.

sections.title: Staff pay below market
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Founders Pledge's: with credit by share of resources on, staff's pay below what they could earn elsewhere counts as an in-kind contribution and gets its share of the outcome. Off by default.

rows.label: Learning gain per student (standard deviations)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Imagine Worldwide: Tanzania (recommendation page)
source.quote: Five large RCTs of IW’s programs show effect sizes of over 0.3 standard deviations in learning gains in Tanzania and Malawi.

rows.explainer: From the page: five large trials "show effect sizes of over 0.3 standard deviations". We take 0.3, the floor stated; the high end, 0.4, is about Founders Pledge's Malawi figure (its sheet's 0.33, its Malawi page's 0.4). This row takes the page's figure as stated; the income section then applies Founders Pledge's usual 25% weight on its 0.1 prior. Founders Pledge's full Malawi model also discounts for funging (0.7) and nets out what the government's money would otherwise do; the page states neither, so this model doesn't apply them, which makes it somewhat favourable.

rows.label: Cost per student (£)

source.title: Founders Pledge, Imagine Worldwide: Tanzania (recommendation page)
source.quote: at just £10 per beneficiary, the program delivers approximately 0.3 learning-adjusted years of schooling (LAYS) per student

rows.explainer: From the page: "at just £10 per beneficiary". The page's 0.3 learning-adjusted years of schooling (LAYS) per student is the same gain in another unit, so it isn't counted again; under the usual LAYS benchmarks 0.3 SD would be more than 0.3 LAYS, which hints that Founders Pledge's figure is already adjusted.

rows.label: Rise in test scores per pound (standard deviations)
rows.explainer: The page's two figures combined: 0.3 standard deviations for £10.

rows.label: US dollars per pound (2024 average)
Rise in test scores per dollar (standard deviations)
Founders Pledge's prior for an education program's effect (standard deviations)
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's 2023 education method doesn't take a measured effect at face value: it averages it with a prior of 0.1 standard deviations (the shared Founders Pledge fact).

rows.label: Weight on the prior
rows.explainer: Our judgment, one value for every Founders Pledge education model whose page doesn't state its shrinking (facts: founders_pledge_2023.prior_weight): 50% on Founders Pledge's prior of 0.1 standard deviations, what Founders Pledge applied to Imagine Worldwide's national scale-up, with 25% (its rule for samples above 2,000) to 75% as the range.

rows.label: Effect after shrinking towards the prior, as a share of the measured effect
Rise in test scores per dollar, after shrinking (standard deviations)
Annual salary increase per standard deviation of learning
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's own figure from its 2023 education report (19.1%), shared with its Imagine Worldwide model. The page's figure stops at test scores; this and the rows below are Founders Pledge's own method for turning test scores into income, applied by us.

rows.label: Replicability adjustment
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's 17.5%: how much of that earnings evidence it expects to hold up, from comparing it with the evidence for deworming.

rows.label: Yearly gain in ln(income) per standard deviation
Years until the income gain starts
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's 8 years from primary school to work.

rows.label: Years the income gain lasts
Household multiplier
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge counts the gain twice because it is shared with the household.

rows.label: Present value of ln(income) gains per standard deviation, per student
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's formula from its Imagine Worldwide model: the yearly gain paid at the start of each of 40 years, discounted, then discounted again for the 8-year wait. Here at the shared discount rate (Your values); Founders Pledge used 4%, the site's default.

rows.label: Increase in ln(income) per dollar
Units of value per dollar
rows.explainer: The income gain valued like every income gain on the site: GiveWell's units of value per unit of ln(consumption) (one unit = doubling one person's income for a year).

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs that mostly buy and hand out goods (nets, drugs, supplements, devices): staff pay is a small part of the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen this program's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Delivery staff are mostly hired locally at local rates, so the gap is small. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Units of value per donor dollar
rows.explainer: Units of value per dollar, in GiveWell's units (one unit = a year of doubled income for one person). With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).

native.unit: standard deviations of test scores per £
